title: OpenSSF Scorecard (Apache-2.0): the JSON result for each repository
readScopes: None for the collector: it reads the result file. Scorecard runs in the customer's pipeline (`scorecard --repo=<repo> --format=json`, or ossf/scorecard-action with results_format json).

checks.title: Scorecard Branch-Protection meets the threshold
checks.scope: A repository on GitHub or GitLab that Scorecard scored; Scorecard reads the forge's settings and history as the token it was given allows.
